5286
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
ANNEXING TO THE MUNICIPALITY OF DIMA-
TALING SITIOS GUILISAN, SALOAGAN AND
MAGAHIS OF THE MUNICIPALITY OF MARGO-
SATUBIG, SAME PROVINCE.
Upon the recommendation of the Secretary of the In-
terior and pursuant to the provisions of section 68 of the
Revised Administrative Code, there is hereby organized
in the Province of Zamboanga a municipality to be known
as the municipality of Dinas, whose territory shall consist
of the northern part of the municipality of Dimataling
and is separated from the said municipality by the fol-
lowing boundary:
From the mouth of Locuban River at the Sambulawan Bay fol-
lowing its course upstream to the source of this river, and from
the said source to the summit of Mt. Bug in an imaginary line
to be drawn in such a way as to leave the barrio of Tiniguangan
in the municipality of Dimataling and the barrio of Bacawan in the
municipality of Dinas.
As herein organized the municipality of Dinas has the
following barrios: Dinas, which shall be the seat of the
municipal government, to consist of the sitios of Nangka,
(lower), 'Toludan, Binuatan, Dapungan, Tinieul and Pu-
latos; Migpuiao, to consist of the sitio of Tagaluboc and
other continuous places; Mirapao, to consist of the sitios
of Dongos, Pantad, Sumuyak, Lubalan, Limunan and Mati;
Legarda, to consist of the sitios of Legarda 1 and 2, Biray,
Guinacap, Betinan and Duminsalao; Libuganan, to consist
of the sitios of Maclob, Laperian, Dao-an and Bulawan;
Kapamanoc, to consist of the sitios of Calilangan, Camanga,
Guiniculalay, Cundum, Pañgapong and Pao; San Pablo,
to consist of the sitios of Culasian, Tandubuay, Tiniapan,
Pantad and Malubog; Calipapa, to consist of the sitios of
Tamburo, Ticala Islands, Tarakan, Dansalan, Buton and
Bubual; Pisaan to consist of the Pisaan Island; Sibul, to
consist of the sitios of Mandag, Igaboy, Linisuan and Cal-
calan; Bacawan, to consist of the sitios of Sumputan,
Upper Dimaya, and other contiguous places; and Ludiong,
to consist of the sitios of Locuban.
The sitios of Guilisan, Salagan, and Magahis of the
municipality of Margosatubig are hereby segregated from
this municipality and annexed to the municipality of
Dimataling, and are hereby organized as barrios under
the same names in the municipality of Dimataling.
The municipality of Dimataling. shall have its present
territory minus the portion thereof included in the munic-
ipality of Dinas, plus the area comprised in the sitios
of Guilisan,. Saloagan, and Magahis of the municipality
of Margosatubig.
The municipality of Margosatubig shall have its present
territory minus the portion thereof comprised in the sitios
of Guilisan, Saloagan, and Magahis.
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
The organization and annexation herein made shall
take effect on November 10. 1950.
Done in the City of Manila, this 9th day of November,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRInO
President of the Philippines
